headline.caveat: 'up to $5B' per Bloomberg's Jul 27, 2026 report; SSI confirmed the NVIDIA partnership but the dollar figure traces to that single report — treat as low-confidence until corroborated by filings

nature_md: NVIDIA plans to invest up to $5B in Safe Superintelligence, Ilya Sutskever's pre-product lab (last marked ~$32B in 2025, with earlier Alphabet/NVIDIA backing). Alongside the investment SSI will deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems, increasing its compute 'by an order of magnitude' over 12 months — notable because SSI had been Google Cloud's largest TPU customer and is shifting toward GPUs. The investment-funds-GPU-purchases loop mirrors NVIDIA's OpenAI and xAI-SPV positions, at a lab with zero revenue.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Would be a non-marketable equity investment on NVIDIA's balance sheet; the associated Vera Rubin deployments are future NVIDIA revenue — equity in, purchases out.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Equity financing for SSI — no revenue exists at the company; proceeds effectively pre-fund compute purchases, largely from NVIDIA.

observations.notes: Single-sourced dollar figure ('up to $5B'); the partnership itself was confirmed by SSI. No filing-level confirmation as of Aug 13, 2026.
